verdict.rationale: Ultrametric covers pieces of this story. You can pin a specific integer version of a process guide (docs-11). `init --dry-run` previews changes before skill files are written (docs-8). Those skill files can be committed to source control (docs-9), so git can handle versioning, review and rollback outside the product. Records and runs expose history (docs-16), and revision-checked updates prevent overwrites (docs-17). However, there is no first-party rollback, and versioning applies to vendor-authored process guides rather than user-defined automations. Missing for 10: native rollback/restore of runs, records or automations; versioning and review of user-authored automations inside the product; independent or hands-on corroboration.
